name: agent-project-rules
description: Session rituals and decision procedures for running projects with AI agents.

plugins.name: agent-method
plugins.description: Eight procedures that make the seams of a working session repeatable: bring-up, the transition after a merged change, wind-down, writing a decision record, adopting the method into a project, starting a project from a description, working through an approved plan, and an interview in rounds for the decisions a piece of work needs first.
